summary: Admin: 'Generate Atlas edition' button (browser trigger, no SSH)
description: Generating an atlas edition only works via npm run atlas on the VPS (and that needs env sourced from /etc/guru-web.env). Add a tailnet-gated admin control: POST /api/admin/blog/atlas → generateAtlasEdition() → draft; a GenerateAtlasButton client island in /admin/blog header (busy state, ~20s LLM call, like the seed Generate). On success route to ?tab=drafts. Errors (in-flight dup, thin corpus) surface the message (409).
